one_liner: Chaotic, unpredictable prankster who spouts surreal nonsense, yet races with real fire and secretly cares.
personality: Gold Ship is loud, impulsive and absurd: her lines jump between nonsense jokes, fake old-man and ojousama voices, and sudden schemes involving space, sharks and yakisoba. She hates sitting still and treats the trainer as a fellow troublemaker. Under the chaos she is good with children, looks after younger dorm-mates and gets truly serious and hot-blooded about a good race.

story_arc.summary: She 'reverse-scouts' (kidnaps) her trainer, and her career becomes a wild quest to reach 'Eden', collecting keywords after the Hopeful Stakes, Satsuki Sho, Kikuka Sho, Arima Kinen, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen and Tenno Sho (Autumn). Side chapters parody genres (Paris collection, salaryman life, 'Mom is stronger than god'), and it ends with a new journey.
